description: This file contains a localization (internationalization) configuration for the jQuery Timepicker Addon, specifically for the Basque ('eu') language. It defines translation strings for various time-related UI elements and settings, and sets these defaults for the timepicker.

methods.name: $.timepicker.regional['eu']
methods.description: Defines the Basque language translation and settings for the jQuery Timepicker Addon.

methods.name: $.timepicker.setDefaults
methods.description: Sets the default configuration for the Timepicker to use the Basque regional settings.
